notes: DOCUMENTED TARGET — NOT RECORDABLE (daemon_capability: incapable; driver_capability: gap:permission-approval). This spec states the arc the row asserts so a future re-assessment has something concrete to compare against; it is NOT expected to pass on aider as it stands, and it is deliberately not weakened to match what aider can do. THE ROW: a blocking dialog attached to NO tool call — nothing carries the entry into waiting and nothing carries the release back out — asserted on BOTH edges, plus a >=15s trailing idle that catches a session left pinned at waiting. Explicitly NOT tool-gate-permission-prompt and NOT permission-gate-non-mutating-tool. AGENT LAYER (satisfied — 2 of the row's 4 triggers present in aider 0.86.2): PRESENT are first-use workspace/provider trust prompts (main.py:122 "No git repo found, create one to track aider's changes (recommended)?"; main.py:191 the .gitignore prompt; onboarding.py:93 "Login to OpenRouter or create a free account?") and a mid-turn product review (Coder.check_tokens, coders/base_coder.py:1396 -> confirm_ask("Try to proceed anyway?") at 1415, raised BEFORE the LLM call so no tool call exists, none is in flight, and none can complete to release it; also "Attempt to fix lint errors?" at 1604 and "Attempt to fix test errors?" at 1620, raised after the run has already finished). ABSENT are a sandbox / network-access confirmation (grep -in sandbox over every .py in the installed package: zero matches; aider has no sandbox model) and MCP elicitation (grep for mcp|MCP|modelcontextprotocol: zero files; aider 0.86.2 ships no MCP client). check_for_urls' "Add URL to the chat?" is deliberately NOT used — it is a web-fetch read and belongs to permission-gate-non-mutating-tool; substituting it is what this row forbids. TRANSPORT LAYER (why this cannot pass): Source is FilesUnderCWD{.aider.chat.history.md, RawLineParser} and the adapter declares no hooks. The question string reaches only the terminal (prompt_session.prompt/input, io.py:871-895). The transcript is not silent — io.tool_error and io.tool_output append blockquotes (io.py:966-973, 995-999), so check_tokens' preamble (`> Your estimated chat context of N tokens exceeds the M token limit for <model>!`) IS written just before aider blocks — but that line rides the same channel as the startup banner, `> Repo-map:` and every warning, carries no dialog marker, and does not match the parser's errorRE (first token "Your"), so it is dropped as status output. And confirm_ask("Try to proceed anyway?") passes no subject, no group and no allow_never, so on the ANSWER nothing is written at all: the release edge has literally no trace. All five waiting rules in state_classifier.go:106-207 are unreachable — the two hook-tier ones because aider has no hooks, transcript_permission_prompt because the parser emits no permission.requested/completed kinds, user_blocking_tool because aider only ever names "Edit" and "Bash", and SignalOpenToolStalled (the transcript-tier fallback built for exactly this situation) because it needs an OPEN tool call — which THIS row's premise excludes by definition, and which aider cannot produce anyway since toolCall() emits ToolUses and ToolResultIDs in one event. What a run would actually show is the INVERSION of the failure the trailing idle exists to catch: while confirm_ask blocks the transcript is quiet, Parser.IdleFlush fires after aiderIdleTurnDoneAfter (1500ms) and synthesizes turn_done, so the session is reported READY while the user stares at the modal — pinned-at-ready rather than pinned-at-waiting. DRIVER LAYER: driver-interactive.sh hard-codes --yes-always, which gates EVERY confirm_ask (io.py:869-870) including the tool-less ones, and aider has no --no-yes-always to append (args.py:760 is action="store_true", not BooleanOptionalAction); there is no keys/approval step (DRIVE_ELICITS="send slash wait_turn interrupt sleep"); and the driver additionally git-inits RUN_CWD and passes --no-gitignore, which suppresses two of the three startup triggers for rig reasons that have nothing to do with aider. VACUOUS-PASS WARNING: aider CAN reach waiting, but only via the trailing-question/cue text classifier (state_classifier.go:437, over LastAssistantText). Because the dialog leaves no usable trace, ANY waiting an aider recording of this cell shows is by construction NOT the dialog — and this row's premise (no tool call in flight) removes the open-tool evidence that could otherwise cross-check it. Never accept a waiting episode here without naming which confirm_ask call produced it. SESSION IDENTITY (same as aider/basic-turn and aider/token-quota-exhausted): the transcript is per-cwd markdown, so the daemon keys the whole session by proc-<PID>; there is no transcript-UUID rollout session. session_birth anchors to recording start UNPINNED so a transient presession row cannot steal the birth, and every later phase chains off it.

text: The proc-<PID> session appears in ready within 2s of the aider REPL launching
The prompt that trips the tool-less dialog drives ready -> working

The tool-less dialog opens (Coder.check_tokens -> confirm_ask("Try to proceed anyway?"), raised before any LLM call) and the session goes working -> waiting with NO tool call in flight. The entry edge is carried by nothing: no tool_use opened, and none will complete to end it. Allow up to 15s, since some agents publish this signal on a timer
The user answers the dialog; the session resumes waiting -> working. The release edge is likewise carried by nothing — no tool result closes it
The turn finishes back to ready — full arc ready -> working -> waiting -> working -> ready

THE LOAD-BEARING PHASE. The session is still ready after a >=15s trailing idle: it does not fall back to waiting, and it was not left pinned at waiting from the dialog onward by something no later event retires
A single process_exited on the session at REPL teardown; the live state immediately before teardown is ready
